name: Regular Expression Generation
description: Regex patterns for a stated intent, with positive and negative match sets — mechanically verified in milliseconds, including a catastrophic-backtracking check.

fields.label: Intent
fields.help: What the pattern should match, in plain language.

fields.label: Must match
fields.help: One test case per line. Every one of these must match. To test a string containing a newline, provide a JSON array of strings instead.

fields.label: Must NOT match
fields.help: One test case per line. To test a string containing a newline, provide a JSON array of strings instead. Include a long adversarial string to expose catastrophic backtracking -- the harness also always runs its own fixed-length stress probes regardless, so this alone is not the only defense.

fields.label: Match timeout (ms)
fields.help: Matching must complete within this budget. Declaring a larger value does not weaken the harness's own catastrophic-backtracking probes, which always use a short, fixed budget of their own.
